balls.text: tries to be cheeky but pays the price... He moves across the stumps to flick the full delivery fine, but only lobs it to short fine leg fielder
this one is fired on the blockhole, but the batsman digs it so hard into the pitch, it bounces over the bowler.. they come back for a second
short and wide, a touch slower though, the batsman gets an underedge to the keeper, but picks up a single
just chips this one over extra cover and manages to beat the infield to pick up a couple
swing and a miss from Vinay.. He was nowhere near the line of the ball, but picks up a bye
he wants to thwack everything to the leg side.. it's not really working anymore for him as he gets hit on the pad trying to play that sweep.. gives him a leg-bye
bowls it full and wide and tests the umpire with that one.. doesn't impress him.. it's called a wide
throws his bat at this fuller one and can only manage to push it to cover for a single
he is trying that shot too often..It looked good the first time.. not so much now as he attempts a sweep at a wide yorker again and makes no connection..
bowls a good yorker on off, the batsman can only dig it out for a single to long off
he charges down the pitch and likes to repeat the sweep from wide outside off, but misses and gets hit on the pads.. picks up a leg bye to backward point
this one is in the air, but beats the fielder at short fine leg.. It was a slower ball wide outside off and the batsman manages to drag it over his shoulder for a couple
this is full and wide outside off and guess what the batsman does.. Surya sweeps him from there and past midwicket for a boundary.. Extraordinary shot
fuller and quicker on off, the batsman digs it out to cover for a single
quick length delivery on off, the batsman dabs it to cover for a quick single
he fires this on the pads, but this one is down the leg side
he almost cuts it all the way to the third-man fielder.. That's what pace does..144 kph
charges down the pitch to a 142 kph length delivery, but this one swings away and is beaten outside off
short and sharp outside off from Aaron, Surya tries to ramp it over third man but makes no connection

Whoa! how far has that gone! not too far unfortunately for Uthappa. he made room, got a slower ball, lifted it towards deep midwicket and looked like he made a good connection... But that went straight into the bucket hands of Starc
nicely done, Yadav moves to off stump, and creates space to whip this back of a length ball with the angle, it is timed so well it goes all the way
backs away to leg, Starc goes full on the stumps, Uthappa guides it to backward point
145 kph short ball, Uthappa swivels for a pull, and the top edge flies high over short fine leg
moves across, uses the angle into him to tuck it through vacant midwicket
full again, much closer to off, he squeezes a drive in the air behind point
full and wide from round the stumps, he tries to square drive, misses
bit more on the angle into the right hander, it straightens on leg, and is worked in front of square
length ball spins away from leg to off, he tucks it to midwicket
googly comes in from just outside off, he nudges it square on the leg side, keeper is after it, but cannot prevent them from taking two
tossed up slowly on leg, he goes back and works it in front of square

there seems no end to Knight Riders' troubles! Now it's Kallis' turn, who seemed alone in doing all the scoring.. He tries to whack this inside out, with the spin, to the stands. The idea was right, the execution wasn't as he failed to get distance on this.. The catch is comfortably taken at deep extra cover
oh he almost kills Kallis with that shot! he jumps out of the crease and smashes the fuller delivery for a single to long-on.. Kallis is sent back as the throw is fired towards his end
more super stuff from Dinda here. Can't remember the last time I used those combination of words. This is full and wide and the batsman is only able to squeeze out to backward point
bowls a low full toss wide outside off, the batsman slices it to deep point for a single
he swings his bat across the line at this length ball, but doesn't get much timing.. Hits it straight to deep midwicket
fuller delivery wide outside off again, the batsman glides it down to third man
short and wide outside off, Uthappa punches it straight to extra cover.
he has been bowling superbly till now.. Another full yorker wide outside off, the batsman gets an inside edge towards midwicket for a single
that was almost punched back to the bowler! Just drops short of him. The ball stopped on Robin a touch..
he makes a lot of room this time and looks to go over point, but doesn't get much power behind the shot
he looks to paddle this fine, but gets a top-edge over the keeper's head for a single
this one is dabbed to point, but Aaron fumbles to allow a single
flatter delivery on the stumps, Murali from midwicket hares across to his left to cut-off the chance of a single
tossed up delivery, the batsman drives it to deep midwicket for a single
he has bowled beautifully till now.. This is another full delivery outside off and beats the inside edge as the batsman looks to drive it through cover
another good yorker outside off, the batsman closes the face of the bat to steer it to square leg
he was walking into this shot, but misses the yorker completely.. Luckily for him, it was outside off
he beats midwicket with a flick off a fuller delivery to pick up a couple
he stays upright and punches the length delivery to long off for a single
bowls a length delivery on off, the batsman dabs it to cover for a quick single
bowls a low full toss that Robin punches to wide mid-on to get off the mark

and that's two in three balls for Aaron! Just like Lynn, Yusuf tries to hammer the ball towards long-on, but he fares even worse.. He could only get it as far as Kohli at mid-off. The investment on Yusuf keeps going sour... When will they divest their stocks on him? He has scored a solitary fifty for them in 46 innings
he walks across to the off stump, but punches the length ball back to the bowler
that's the end of Lynn as he slaps a length delivery straight to AB at long-off. Lynn had slowed down a bit in the last few overs and he didn't really time it as well as he would have liked.
looks to swing the length delivery over midwicket but is beaten as this one slip between the bat .. was not too far from the leg stump
good pacy length delivery on the stumps, the batsman punches it to long on for a single
he gives away only a single as Kallis punches this to wide long-off
attempts a slower ball but this is way down the leg side
just like two deliveries ago, Lynn only manages to toe-end this half-volley to long off
low full toss on off, the batsman gets an inside edge behind square leg
he wouldn't be happy with the result there. This was a half-volley on off and Lynn only managed a bit of toe-end on it, pushing it just over the bowler's head
length delivery on off, the batsman punches it firmly back at the bowler, who manages to get a boot on it.. only to deflect it towards mid-on
length delivery outside off, the batsman cracks it to deep point off the back foot
slightly short and Lynn is quick to swivel and pulls this to deep square leg..
he looks to cut this through the off side, but doesn't get the timing as the googly comes into him..
now he pushes the legspinner to deep cover for a single
he fires up another googly but Kallis smartly picks up another couple to deep midwicket.. He is pushing these very softly
good delivery on off, Kallis can only slice it to point
it's a full delivery and the batsman tucks it to deep midwicket with soft hands to pick up two
top-spinner on off stump, Kallis waits on the back foot and dabs it to midwicket for a quick single
slog sweep again, this time it is Kallis.. Gets this on the middle off the bat and whacks it deep over square leg.. Another six.. Murali being taken apart here.
here comes the slog sweep again, but it's off the inside edge to deep square leg for a single
this one keeps a touch low, but Kallis manages to nudge it to midwicket
he looks to sweep this across the line, much like Lynn.. but makes no connection and is hit high on the pads
bowls it wide outside off, no spin on this one.. the batsman waits on the back foot and punches it to deep cover
this is a googly now, the batsman comes forward and pushes it to cover
length delivery, this is chopped behind point

oh this is painful for the bowler! Lynn goes back and whacks the flatter delivery to deep midwicket, where Starc lines himself up, but as he completes the catch, he touches the ropes.. He has not only given the batsman a life, he is given away six runs..
he allows the ball to turn away, then pushes it to deep cover for a single
flatter delivery on the leg stump line, the batsman pushes it to long on for a single
he waits on the back foot and punches this through cover for a single
tossed up again and Lynn goes down on his knee again, this is whacked high and handsome over deep square leg for another biggie
flatter delivery, defended back down the pitch
super stuff from AB at cover, but he can't prevent the single.. The batsman was struggling though
tossed up on the stumps, the batsman dabs it to midwicket for a single
Lynn was waiting for Murali too as he goes down on his knee and launches it over midwicket.. this is high and long and hits the giant TV screen which is showing a picture of .. Murali..
he comes down the pitch and punches it over cover.. But again, it's not hit too far..Just evades AB running backwards.. Maybe Steven Smith would have taken that..
this is short and wide outside off, but it shot up quite high.. The batsman chases it but it keeps going over the bat
it's a yorker outside off, Lynn, who was making room, stretches and blocks it out towards cover for a change and picks up a single
Lynn seems to have a liking for two things - Murali and Murali at mid-off. He punches this length delivery to the same fielder at the same position again
he chops down the length delivery down to third man to bring Lynn to strike
fuller delivery on the stumps, he defends it back down the pitch

more bad bounce at cover now.. The batsman punches it on the up and it hits Kohli's jaw as he was bending down to stop that.. He is bleeding and he is going off now...That edge of the square seems to be the culprit.. The first one cost 4 runs.. the second has cost them RCB their captain
he tries to go wide outside off again but goes too wide
No chance for Dinda this time as this half-volley is thumped between extra cover and Dinda this time
what has the cover fielder done there! Dinda it is. The batsman drives it beautifully, but this just spins away from the fielder.. Can't blame him for that.
another dot ball as the bowler hurls it wide outside off, but just inside the marker.. Lynn fails to get a bat on it
good delivery from Ablie now.. A yorker outside off, the batsman is beaten as he tries to chop it to the off side
fuller and wider outside off, the batsman slices it behind point to pick up a single to third man
moves leg side again and looks to hoick it over mid-on, but this is not full enough and beats the inside edge
now there is some power on this shot! He moves a little to the leg side and drives it all along the ground, between the bowler and Murali at mid-off
short and quick outside off, the batsman looks to pull and is hurried by the pace, but manages to clear the midwicket fielder
goes full and fires it on the stumps, the batsman comes forward and pushes it to mid-on
extra bounce beats Kallis as he tries to cut the short of length delivery
he picks up his third run to mid-off with another firm push.. This was straight to Murali, but he threw it towards the stumps like a five year old.. no force behind it

what a shot that was! There is absolutely no room on this short of length delivery, but Kallis arches back and not only manages to create room, but also times it perfectly behind point to pick up a boundary
he still can't find the gap.. It's a full delivery and the batsman tries to push it through cover without moving forward, hits it straight to fielder
short of length delivery outside off, the batsman defends it to backward point
it's a length delivery outside off but Kallis pushes it to cover off the back foot
on the pads and Kallis flicks it straight to square leg
he is bowling quick here.. this one flies off the outside edge very quickly down to third man
Murali is on the edge of the circle at mid-off and Lynn spots an opportunity for a single with a push to him
back of length delivery on off, he defends it to backward point

that was not too far from the mid-on fielder! Kallis punches this through the line and in the air and although it looks to be a good shot in the end, a little to the right and that would have gone straight to mid-on
he gets off the mark with a firm push to the right of mid-off fielder

leading edge to cover point now! It's RCB's bowlers who are making all the positive moves. This is so much better than the first delivery - fuller on off, with some shape on it. Pandey looks to play a loose push towards mid-on but closes the face too early.. Kohli takes a simple catch
short and wide, Pandey is a decent batsman and he is not going to miss out on these ones.. he arches back and punches it over point for a boundary
this is stylishly clipped over square leg.. The ball is a touch short and even though he is still hurried by the pace, he leans back and manages to get a couple to Murali at deep backward square leg
fuller delivery on the stumps, Kallis wanted to push it down straight but the bat rotates in his hands and he ends up pushing it past midwicket
short of length outside off, the batsman glides it down to third man

no he can't! Gambhir is gone first ball. That is some record to have.. Three ducks in a row for Gambhir. This is full, fast and hitting middle and leg stump. Gambhir is too slow to bring his bat down and is caught plumb in front. He falls over as he tries to flick it
he is surprised a touch with the pace on this short of length delivery, hurries him into his defensive shot. He takes a single as the ball drops close to the stumps
gets one to swing in first up.. Kallis defends it solidly down the pitch
low full toss, he hasn't timed it. it goes only as far as long off. This is a jailbreak of a monumental standard..
fuller delivery on off, thumped down the ground and they pick up a couple to long on

this is a blinder! this is madness.. this is the maddest baddest ever catch.. AB did what AB does.. Whacks the short of length delivery to deep midwicket, where Lynn lines himself up for the catch.. but he slips.. Despite that, he somehow straightens his body on the ground, keeps an eye on the ball, arches his body back and takes a catch sitting down.. freakish catch.. KKR are stealing this one.. Lynn is a hero.. watch that catch to believe that..
that's a full toss, high full toss outside of.. it's hit in the air towards cover but lands safely.. could have gone outside had he made a proper connection
he walks all around the pitch before sweeping the length delivery to deep midwicket.. just a single
it's a yorker length slower ball from round the wicket, Albie pushes it to long on for a single
he looks to reverse paddle this full and wide delivery.. makes no connection.. How did it ever come to this..

full and wide outside off, the batsman digs it out straight to point and takes off for a single.. A direct hit would have made it interesting.. Manish Pandey misses... AB would have probably made it as well

and he's gone... ironically to a ball that he timed so well.. Probably his best connection of the day.. It was full and wide and he crashed it over point, but straight to deep point..Gambhir is pumped
he is standing outside off and gets a high full toss, poor bowling this... Yuvraj gets a top-edge towards long-on and gets a couple.. that's three runs
comes round the wicket and fires it full outside off, Yuvi looks to steer it to third man, but misses..
this one is good, fired in full on the middle and leg stump, AB digs it out to long on for a single
he bowls it full and wide and for someone like AB, it's a freebee.. It's clobbered over mid-off
short length ball on the body, AB whacks it straight to deep midwicket.. Just a single.. he keeps the strike
it's a yorker outside off, Yuvraj manages to dig it out to long on for a single
gets a fuller delivery and it provides a release as Yuvraj thumps it over cover for a four
goes round the wicket and bowls a slower one that beats Yuvraj's slog across the line
quick short ball to Yuvraj Singh.. he thinks about pulling it, but sways away from it
cramps him for room with a straight length delivery, but AB adjusts to punch it to deep midwicket
shortish outside off, it's slapped powerfully to deep cover
he punches the length delivery straight to midwicket
length delivery on off, the angled bat comes out again, Yuvraj picks up a single to point
he comes round the wicket and bowls length on off, Yuvraj, for once, plays it with a straight bat, but can't beat a diving Kallis
a misfield at cover allows AB to pick up a single
length delivery on off, the batsman punches it to cover
AB goes deep in the crease to work this away to deep midwicket for a single

that's a corker from Narine! It has to be a very good ball to beat someone in the form of his life and it is. This is tossed up further, spins in and beats the inside edge of the bat, flicks the front pad and then takes the off bail ..
poor ball from Narine.. this is a full toss and a high one.. Kohli smashes it over midwicket with ease
quicker on the off stump, Kohli defends it off the back foot
width provided and Kohli is not going to miss out on those, punches it to deep extra cover to pick up a couple
tosses it up and gets some offspin, Kohli defends it off the back foot
length delivery on the stumps, easily nudged to square leg for a single
length delivery outside off, he chops it to deep point
he looks to make room, but that's a bluff.. The bowler fires it on his pads and all the batsman has to do is to get some bat on it.. he flicks it to deep backward square leg boundary
this stays low and beats the bat as the batsman looks to punch it through cover
poor position from Yuvraj as he looks to turn this length delivery to the leg side, but gets an outside edge to point
drives the fuller delivery to deep extra cover for a single
fuller and wider, draws the batsman forward and beats the bat
he cuts this one straight to point
slightly fuller, this time the batsman comes forward, dabs it to point for a single and then picks up an extra as the throw at non-striker's end is not gathered
quicker on the stumps, this is short enough and gives the batsman time to punch it to deep midwicket
it's the doosra, but Kohli plays it to point off the back foot easily
he tucks this one to fine leg as the line is slightly leg-sidish.. gives the strike back to Kohli
fuller delivery on off, wristed straight to midwicket
this is straighter, allows him to dab it to midwicket for a single
length delivery on off, Yuvraj tries to play that push to third man, finds backward point.. no straight bat shots for him
allows this one to come in before clipping it to fine leg for a single
this is even better.. just punches it through the same gap again.. just timing and a bit of placement..
beautiful! Kohli leans forward and uses his wrists to punch this with precision in the gap at extra cover
he comes forward and defends the fuller delivery straight down the pitch
just outside off and this time Yuvraj manages to cut it late to pick up a couple
he still can't get it away, pushes it to cover
some spin for the bowler, but it's slightly short and Yuvraj manages to push it to midwicket
quicker delivery on the stumps, Yuvraj punches it to mid-on
flatter outside off, Kohli stays on the back foot and clips it to deep square leg
length delivery wide outside off, the batsman pushes it to deep cover to keep the strike
pace, no pace, spin, no spin, Kohli plays his own game.. He gets a back of length delivery and whacks it over midwicket
he moves to the leg side to make some room, then slices the fuller delivery over point
no no.. crank up I said.. Umesh bowled it at 135.5 kph.. Yuvraj can still smack those and he does it with style.. That was the shot of the old days, over midwicket and into the stands
back of length on off, Kohli dabs it to deep square leg with utmost ease for a single
fuller delivery outside off, Kohli misses out on some runs as he drives this straight to cover

short ball again, he chooses to play the pull belatedly.. gets thick top edge that hits him on his helmet.. the ball doesn't go anywhere. A shadow of a man who used to hit these a long way in the past
short ball comes in and Yuvraj is in a tangle.. he is nowhere near the ball but his position goes completely awry..
easy peasy for Kohli as he whips this length delivery through midwicket to pick up three runs
length delivery on the pads, lets Yuvraj off the hook as the batsman clips it to fine leg
length delivery outside off, again, he pushes this to backward point with an angled bat..
back of length delivery, Kohli nudges it to square leg for a single.. Yuvi looks around to check if he wants to come back for a second.. but he doesn't
length delivery outside off, Yuvraj continues to play with an angled bat, pushes it to point
waits an extra fraction of a second, then guides the length ball down to third man
not much feet movement from Yuvraj, but he manages to push this length delivery through cover for a single
he shuffles across and clips the length delivery with ease to deep square leg
he gets off the mark with a dabbed single to cover off a length ball
length delivery angled across the batsman, Yuvraj leaves it alone

now it's Parthiv's turn.. He is beaten by the extra bounce on this pitch.. Parthiv wanted to clip it to the leg side, but this slower delivery got big on him and the leading edge just popped up for the cover fielder..
that takes off from back of length and flies past the outside edge.. Kohli was looking to guide it to third man, but he was lucky not to edge it
ever so solid.. defends the length ball off the front foot
finally KKR strike! This was the offcutter and Takawale looked to work it away on the leg side, got hit right in front of the middle stump.. Easy decision for the umpire
slower delivery outside off, the batsman looked to push it towards point but gets a useful little under edge through the vacant slip region..
he walks across to the off side and whips the length delivery to fine leg for a single
length delivery outside off, the batsman guides it to third man for a single
short delivery outside off, Parthiv looks to guide it over the keeper's head but misses
solid shot off the back foot this time.. He gets up on his toes and punches the back of length delivery to deep cover
on the pads again, the batsman doesn't get any bat on it, but he won't mind as this skims of the pads to the boundary
he strays on the pads and Takawale picks up a couple with a neat clip off his pads, at deep backward square leg
allows this back of length delivery to come to him before guiding it to third man
who doesn't love a bit of medium pace.! Parthiv certainly does.. he whacks this back of length delivery with a lot of authority to deep midwicket boundary
length delivery and Takawale is taking some toll on this bowling now.. he swings across the line and gets enough bat on it to pick up a boundary over wide mid on
he stays on the back foot and defends the length delivery to cover point
he is growing in confidence now.. arches back and ramps the short of length delivery over the slip fielder.. Wonderful shot by Takawale
it's the best shot Takawale has played today.. He moves to the leg side, gets a 147 kph fuller delivery that he thumps over the bowler's head.. one bounce and four..
he makes room and looks to swing it over cover, but gets a thick top edge that evades the mid-off fielder.. Gambhir can't reach that one..
length delivery on off, the batsman defends it to short cover, but picks up a single
it's the conventional offspinner, the batsman tucks it straight to short fine leg
slightly slower this time, the batsman defends it to backward point
quicker one on the stumps, the batsman defends. i don't think he knows which ball is doing what
he beats him with a quicker one as the batsman plays inside the line.. Robin fails to take that cleanly
flatter and quicker, the batsman defends it to the off side
quicker delivery on off, the batsman chops it behind point for a quick single
that's a pacy short ball, the batsman ducks under it and the keeper has to leap to catch that one
now the batsman rubs salt on Morkel's wounds, flicking this length delivery through backward square leg for yet another boundary
there is a slip in place but this one flies between the keeper and that fielder.. Uthappa was moving towards the leg side and is surprised as this thick outside edge flies quickly past him
he corrects the line to outside off and this flies quickly past the outside edge
jeez, what timing on that one.. He was opening his stance, the bowler followed him with a length ball, Takawale just flicks him over square leg and that races quickly...
this one is quick too.. hits the batsman on the thigh pad as the batsman looks to clip it to the leg side..
manages to get his swing down in time.. not the best of timing behind that, but it clears mid-on
looks to heave this over mid-on but that's too quick for him.. 145.4 kph.. He only manages to hit it as far as mid-on
looks to punch this fuller delivery down the ground, but doesn't get any timing on that.. picks up a quick single to mid-off
fuller length delivery outside off, Parthiv reaches out and slices it over point to find the boundary again.. Doesn't move his feet much, just throws his bat at that
another length delivery on the stumps, this time Takawale is able to push it to wide mid-on to get off strike
length delivery at 143.5 kph, the batsman gets behind the line and defends
another one of those quick short of length deliveries.. batsman swings, batsman misses
that extra bounce.. that menacing stuff.. 149 kph.. Parthiv swings.. meets thin air.
short delivery, the batsman rolls his wrists on it as he tries to pull, hits it straight to midwicket
stays on the back foot and opens the bat face to run it down to third man
extra bounce does it for Morkel.. It was short and wide and would have been whacked if he was a shorter bowler.. but this one takes off and beats the batsman's cut shot
back of length delivery outside off, the batsman dabs it to third man for a single
length delivery outside off, Takawale punches it to cover point
length delivery, but this is down the leg side
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman punches it to mid-on and calls for a quick single as Yusuf takes times to control the ball
short and wide, slapped hard through the crowded point region.. Manish Pandey flew to his left, but that was spanked.. no chance for anyone
length delivery on off, the batsman defends it off the back foot
that's the problem pace creates! Parthiv looks to pull a short ball, but is not in control at all. The ball balloons over the square leg fielder.. He is lucky there.. very very lucky
good start by the bowler, length delivery on off, 140 kph, the batsman defends it back to the bowler
